items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: I left and went to New York with Harold Dajon.

ctx.x: I, yeah, he was, he was pretty good. Good touch? Yeah, he was. You know, uh, he was with the band. He wasn't with the others in the band too long with him because not long after he come in the band is when I left and went to New York with Harold Dajon. Mm-hmm. That's when we took Blackie San Diego. Yeah. Because, uh, Pernell was playing with Harold a while and Harold got rid of Pernell and took Blackie. Yeah. His brother. Well. They tell me Pernell tore up New York and they went and got R.T. in my thing for him.…

But anyway, somebody like Pernell, you know, it seems to me that when I heard him, he was playing solo piano, that must have been in the 40s, late 40s. You know, maybe Dan's International or someplace like that. And, uh, he could do that. But I wondered how he was in a band in a rhythm section. Because you never know unless you're in the rhythm section.
